source: HCG System Tester repository (docs/lifeos). Proposed roadmap — no System Tester quest import existed in HCG-LifeOS when 0.1.0 was built. Import manually; nothing here awards XP.

quests.title: HCG System Tester — modular hardware discovery & diagnostics platform
quests.details: Native macOS (Swift/SwiftUI) platform that discovers connected systems, explains exactly which connectivity layers are verified, and runs authorised read-only diagnostics through interchangeable adapters. Principle: EVERYTHING IS INTERCHANGEABLE.

quests.title: Acceptance: connect a real USB device and see it in System Tester
quests.details: First acceptance milestone. Build 0.1.0 on the MacBook Pro (M4 Max) and confirm live detection of real hardware.
subtasks: Build with Xcode (App/HCGSystemTester.xcodeproj) or scripts/build-app.sh
Run swift run hcg-probe --watch and plug/unplug a device
USB storage device: BSD disk + link speed shown
Smartphone (iPhone and/or Android): status Adapter required, not Connected
USB hub: children drawn behind the hub in the Visualizer
USB serial board: /dev/cu.* shown
Gaming controller: identified as controller, not console
PlayStation/Xbox console: record that host-to-host USB does not enumerate
Export a report and record compatibility evidence for every device

quests.title: Core engine 0.1.0: identification, connectivity layers, adapter SDK, diagnostics
quests.details: Delivered in the initial commit; verify on hardware before closing.
subtasks: IOKit USB + Thunderbolt discovery with live notifications
Five-layer connectivity assessment
State machine (detected … disconnected)
Adapter manifest SDK + validator
Diagnostic engine with authorisation gate and audit log
Reports: Markdown, JSON, hcg.diagnostic-report/1

quests.title: Serial adapter: first verified functional communication
quests.details: Open a serial port read-only after explicit per-device authorisation; loopback/echo test to verify the Functional communication layer for the first time on real hardware.
subtasks: Privileged permission grant UI
Read-only open with termios configuration from the adapter schema
Loopback echo test with measured round-trip latency
Close-on-disconnect lifecycle

quests.title: Network & Bluetooth discovery backends
quests.details: Local-network (DNS-SD/Bonjour, Network framework path monitoring) and Core Bluetooth discovery with the required macOS permissions.
subtasks: NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription + documented service types only
Reachability/latency diagnostics to user-specified hosts
Core Bluetooth advertisement discovery (read-only)
Visualizer network group

quests.title: Storage health where supported
quests.details: SMART/health data via bridges that expose it through supported macOS APIs; otherwise report the limitation.

quests.title: PlayStation & Xbox research modules: documented interfaces only
quests.details: Record which interfaces consoles actually expose per connection role; investigate documented network services and authorised developer interfaces. No bypass of authentication, DRM or firmware protections.
subtasks: Physical test: Mac ↔ console USB (expected: no enumeration)
Controller diagnostics over USB and Bluetooth
Console network presence via documented discovery only
Compatibility report

quests.title: Smart appliance & IoT adapters (Matter, MQTT, manufacturer APIs)
quests.details: Read-only measurements and health from documented interfaces; explicit authorisation before any setting change; never safety-critical functions.

quests.title: HCG Server: Device Link pairing and diagnostic result sync
quests.details: Implement hcg.devicelink/1 pairing (invitation code, P-256 installation key, pinned TLS 1.3) and share hcg.diagnostic-report/1 reports. No remote command execution.

quests.title: HCG Connect sign-in (after client registration)
quests.details: Register a System Tester client in HCG Connect, then add PKCE loopback sign-in. App stays usable locally without it.

quests.title: HCG Nexus: register System Tester in the Interchange Protocol
quests.details: Nexus HIP v1 registry is compiled into Nexus and iOS-only; add a System Tester entry (Nexus project change) using hcgsystemtester://open/<route> navigation.

quests.title: Shared hardware adapter spec with HCG Signal Contractor
quests.details: Propose hcg.adapter-manifest/1 as the shared adapter specification and exchange device identifiers/capabilities to avoid duplicate discovery stacks.

quests.title: Adapter SDK v2: signed adapter packages built with HCG Executable Maker
quests.details: Package approved adapter projects, signature verification before approval, version management across installs.

quests.title: Distribution build (manual publication only)
quests.details: Developer ID signing, hardened runtime, notarisation, DMG/pkg via HCG Executable Maker. Publication to HCG Store/GitHub Releases stays a manual founder decision.
